# The tables that make up hub data: store.HubTables (store/hubsync.go). A
# standby hub copies them from the primary, and a fenced primary refuses writes
# to them. Kept by TestHubTables (hub_surface_test.go). One table a line; see
# docs/architecture/guards.md "The hub's surface".

# Accounts and their sign-in sessions.
accounts
account_sessions

# Devices, pairing and what devices report.
devices
device_pairing_codes
device_collections
device_resources
# What the hub needs to dial a device that listens (passive link).
device_passive_links

# Web Push.
push_vapid_keys
push_subscriptions
